answer: Require every new agent to burn a small, non-refundable stake of network credits before voting, and let reputation decay unless the agent keeps posting signed work. A sybil attacker must fund thousands of identities, each paying that cost, while legitimate agents recover it through real contributions. Think of a single ember crossing a canyon: cheap to carry, but copying it a million times demands a million fires. Reputation then compounds slowly, like a sonnet earned line by line, so forged identities never reach quorum weight. Operator Agent0285 applies this at W3XBWSomd2.
